results.sql:
WITH regional_sales AS (
  SELECT s.region_name,
         SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS region_net_sales
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND s.country_code = 'HU'
    AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND f.sales_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.region_name
),
total_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(region_net_sales) AS total_net_sales
  FROM regional_sales
)
SELECT rs.region_name,
       rs.region_net_sales / ts.total_net_sales AS fraction_of_total
FROM regional_sales rs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
ORDER BY rs.region_name
assumptions: Calendar year 2024 is used (2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31).
Fractions are expressed as decimals between 0 and 1.
Test stores are excluded from the calculation.
Cancelled receipts are excluded.
All amounts are converted to EUR using the exchange rate of each sale date.

WITH regional_sales AS (

         SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.date = f.sales_date
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency

    AND s.country_code = 'HU'

total_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_sales_eur) AS total_eur

)

       rs.net_sales_eur / ts.total_eur AS share
FROM regional_sales rs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
ORDER BY rs.region_name
assumptions: A 2024-es év a fiskális évet jelenti, amely 2024. március 1-től 2025. február 28-ig tart.

Az euróban mért magyar bevétel az összes magyar üzlet (nem teszt, nem törölt) nettó árbevételét jelenti a fiskális 2024-ben.

       SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate)

FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id

SELECT p.category_en,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.is_private_label
           THEN (f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate ELSE 0 END)
         / NULLIF(SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate), 0) AS private_label_share
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id
JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency

Returns are included as negative lines in both numerator and denominator.

WITH fy2025_sales AS (

         SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f

  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2025-03-01'
    AND f.sales_date <= DATE '2025-10-03'
  GROUP BY s.country_code
),
fy2026_sales AS (
  SELECT s.country_code,
         SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2026-03-01'
    AND f.sales_date <= DATE '2026-10-03'
  GROUP BY s.country_code
)
SELECT COALESCE(fy2026.country_code, fy2025.country_code) AS country_code,
       fy2025.net_sales_eur AS fy2025_net_sales_eur,
       fy2026.net_sales_eur AS fy2026_net_sales_eur,
       CASE WHEN fy2025.net_sales_eur IS NOT NULL AND fy2025.net_sales_eur != 0
            THEN (fy2026.net_sales_eur / fy2025.net_sales_eur) - 1
            ELSE NULL
       END AS fractional_growth
FROM fy2025_sales fy2025
FULL OUTER JOIN fy2026_sales fy2026 ON fy2025.country_code = fy2026.country_code
ORDER BY country_code
assumptions: Fiscal year 2026 is incomplete as of today (2026-10-04); data is available through 2026-10-03.

To enable fair comparison of incomplete FY2026 against FY2025, matching month/day endpoints are used: FY2025 data from 2025-03-01 to 2025-10-03 is compared with FY2026 data from 2026-03-01 to 2026-10-03 (both covering 7 months and 3 days from the fiscal year start).
Fractional growth is calculated as (FY2026 / FY2025) - 1; a zero or missing FY2025 denominator results in NULL growth.
Revenue means net sales in euro (gross amount - discount - VAT, divided by the exchange rate of the sale date).

  GROUP BY s.country_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date), p.is_private_label
),
gap_by_year_country AS (
  SELECT country_code,
         year,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_private_label THEN net_sales_eur ELSE 0 END) AS private_label_sales,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_private_label THEN net_sales_eur ELSE 0 END) AS branded_sales,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_private_label THEN net_sales_eur ELSE 0 END) - 
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_private_label THEN net_sales_eur ELSE 0 END) AS gap
  FROM sales_by_year_country_label

)

       MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN gap END) AS gap_2024_eur,
       MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN gap END) AS gap_2025_eur,
       MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN gap END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN gap END) AS gap_change_eur
FROM gap_by_year_country
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code

WITH regional_sales AS (
  SELECT s.region_name,
         SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS region_net_sales
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND s.country_code = 'HU'
    AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND f.sales_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.region_name
),
total_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(region_net_sales) AS total_net_sales
  FROM regional_sales
)
SELECT rs.region_name,
       rs.region_net_sales / ts.total_net_sales AS fraction_of_total
FROM regional_sales rs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
ORDER BY rs.region_name
assumptions: Calendar year 2024 is used (2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31).

results.sql:
WITH regional_sales AS (
  SELECT s.region_name,
         SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS region_net_sales
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND s.country_code = 'HU'
    AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND f.sales_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.region_name
),
total_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(region_net_sales) AS total_net_sales
  FROM regional_sales
)
SELECT rs.region_name,
       rs.region_net_sales / ts.total_net_sales AS fraction_of_total
FROM regional_sales rs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
ORDER BY rs.region_name
assumptions: Calendar year 2024 is used (2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31).
Fractions are expressed as decimals between 0 and 1.
Test stores are excluded from the calculation.
Cancelled receipts are excluded.
All amounts are converted to EUR using the exchange rate of each sale date.

WITH regional_sales AS (
  SELECT s.region_name,
         SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.date = f.sales_date
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND s.country_code = 'HU'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 2024
  GROUP BY s.region_name
),
total_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_sales_eur) AS total_eur
  FROM regional_sales
)
SELECT rs.region_name,
       rs.net_sales_eur / ts.total_eur AS share
FROM regional_sales rs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
ORDER BY rs.region_name
assumptions: A 2024-es év a fiskális évet jelenti, amely 2024. március 1-től 2025. február 28-ig tart.
A részesedés törtben van kifejezve (0-1 között), nem százalékban.
Az euróban mért magyar bevétel az összes magyar üzlet (nem teszt, nem törölt) nettó árbevételét jelenti a fiskális 2024-ben.

results.sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date) AS month_number,
       SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate)
         / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS avg_basket_eur
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
  AND NOT f.is_return
  AND NOT s.is_test_store
  AND s.country_code = 'AT'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date) = 2024
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date)
ORDER BY avg_basket_eur ASC, month_number ASC
LIMIT 1
assumptions: Average basket is calculated as the sum of net sales in euro divided by the count of distinct non-return receipts, at the monthly level.
Return receipts are excluded from both numerator and denominator.
Cancelled receipts and test stores are excluded.
Ties in average basket value are broken by selecting the earlier month.
Calendar months are used (January = 1, December = 12).

WITH monthly_baskets AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date) AS month_num,
         SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales,
         COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipt_count
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT f.is_return
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND s.country_code = 'AT'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date) = 2024
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date)
)
SELECT month_num,
       ROUND(net_sales / NULLIF(receipt_count, 0), 2) AS avg_basket_eur
FROM monthly_baskets
ORDER BY avg_basket_eur ASC, month_num ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH hu_data AS (
  SELECT SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_date), 0) AS avg_daily_net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND s.country_code = 'HU'
    AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND f.sales_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
at_data AS (
  SELECT SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_date), 0) AS avg_daily_net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND s.country_code = 'AT'
    AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND f.sales_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT hu_data.avg_daily_net_sales_eur - at_data.avg_daily_net_sales_eur AS difference_eur
FROM hu_data, at_data
assumptions: Calendar year 2025 is used (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31)
Average daily net sales is calculated as net sales divided by trading days (distinct dates with valid sales), not calendar days
Net sales are converted to euro using the exchange rate of each sale date
Cancelled receipts and test stores are excluded
The difference is signed: Hungary's average daily net sales minus Austria's average daily net sales

results.sql: SELECT s.country_code, -SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS revenue_deduction_eur FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency JOIN dim_date d ON d.date = f.sales_date WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled AND NOT s.is_test_store AND f.is_return AND d.fiscal_year = 2024 GROUP BY s.country_code ORDER BY s.country_code
assumptions: Returns are filtered with is_return = TRUE to isolate return receipt lines only.
The result is negated to show positive deduction amounts (returns reduce revenue, so the negative net sales from returns are shown as positive deductions).
Fiscal year 2024 runs from 2024-03-01 to 2025-02-28 (fiscal years begin on March 1 and are named after their starting calendar year).
Exchange rates are applied per sale date and currency to convert to euro.
Test stores and cancelled receipts are excluded per standard business rules.

results.sql:
SELECT p.category_en,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.is_private_label
           THEN (f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate ELSE 0 END)
         / NULLIF(SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate), 0) AS private_label_share
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id
JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
  AND NOT s.is_test_store
  AND s.country_code = 'HU'
  AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND f.sales_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.category_en
ORDER BY private_label_share DESC, p.category_en ASC
LIMIT 1
assumptions: Calendar year 2025 means 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.
Private-label share is calculated as the ratio of signed net sales of private-label products to total signed net sales in euro, at the category level.
Ties are broken alphabetically by English category name.
Returns are included as negative lines in both numerator and denominator.

results.sql: WITH fy2025_sales AS (SELECT s.country_code, SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled AND NOT s.is_test_store AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2025-03-01' AND f.sales_date <= DATE '2026-10-03' GROUP BY s.country_code), fy2026_sales AS (SELECT s.country_code, SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled AND NOT s.is_test_store AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND f.sales_date <= DATE '2026-10-03' GROUP BY s.country_code) SELECT COALESCE(fy2025.country_code, fy2026.country_code) AS country_code, fy2025.net_sales_eur AS fy2025_net_sales_eur, fy2026.net_sales_eur AS fy2026_net_sales_eur, (fy2026.net_sales_eur / NULLIF(fy2025.net_sales_eur, 0)) - 1 AS fractional_growth FROM fy2025_sales fy2025 FULL OUTER JOIN fy2026_sales fy2026 ON fy2025.country_code = fy2026.country_code ORDER BY country_code
assumptions: Fiscal year 2025 runs from 2025-03-01 to 2026-02-28; fiscal year 2026 runs from 2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28.

FY2026 data is incomplete (only through 2026-10-03, the last available day before today). To compare incomplete FY2026 with complete FY2025, matching calendar endpoints are used: FY2025 data from 2025-03-01 to 2026-10-03 is compared with FY2026 data from 2026-03-01 to 2026-10-03 (same calendar window within each fiscal year).
Fractional growth is calculated as (FY2026 / FY2025) - 1.
Revenue means net sales in euro (gross amount - discount - VAT, divided by the exchange rate of the sale date).
Cancelled receipts and test stores are excluded.
A NULL growth result indicates missing or zero data in the denominator.

WITH annual_avg AS (
  SELECT SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_date), 0) AS avg_daily_sales
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND s.country_code = 'HU'
    AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND f.sales_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
daily_sales AS (
  SELECT f.sales_date,
         SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS daily_net_sales
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND s.country_code = 'HU'
    AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND f.sales_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY f.sales_date
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS days_exceeding_average
FROM daily_sales, annual_avg
WHERE daily_sales.daily_net_sales > annual_avg.avg_daily_sales
assumptions: Calendar year 2025 is used (January 1 to December 31, 2025)
Average daily net sales is calculated as total net sales divided by trading days (days with valid sales), not calendar days
Only Hungary (country_code = 'HU') is included
Cancelled receipts and test stores are excluded
Returns are included in net sales as negative lines

WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date) AS month_num,
         SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND s.country_code = 'AT'
    AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2025-02-01'
    AND f.sales_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sales_date)
),
month_changes AS (
  SELECT month_num,
         net_sales_eur,
         LAG(net_sales_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_num) AS prev_month_sales,
         net_sales_eur - LAG(net_sales_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_num) AS mom_change
  FROM monthly_sales
)
SELECT month_num,
       mom_change
FROM month_changes
WHERE mom_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY mom_change ASC,
         month_num ASC
LIMIT 1
assumptions: Calendar months are used (February through December 2025 means 2025-02-01 through 2025-12-31).
Month-on-month change is calculated as current month net sales minus previous month net sales.
A 'drop' is a negative change; the largest absolute drop is the most negative value.
Ties are broken by selecting the earlier month.
Test stores are excluded from the calculation.
Cancelled receipts are excluded from the calculation.

results.sql:
SELECT d.weekday,
       CASE d.weekday
         WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1
         WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2
         WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3
         WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4
         WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5
         WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6
         WHEN 'Sunday' THEN 7
       END AS weekday_number,
       SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate)
         / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS avg_basket_eur
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.date = f.sales_date
JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
  AND NOT f.is_return
  AND NOT s.is_test_store
  AND s.country_code = 'AT'
  AND f.sales_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND f.sales_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY d.weekday
ORDER BY weekday_number
assumptions: Calendar year 2025 is used (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31).
Return receipts are excluded from both numerator and denominator of the average basket calculation.
Only days with actual sales receipts are included in the result (the GROUP BY naturally excludes closed days and holidays with no sales).
Weekday numbers follow the convention Monday=1 through Sunday=7.

  FROM fact_sales f

    AND f.sales_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

WITH sales_by_year_country_label AS (
  SELECT s.country_code,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date) AS year,
         p.is_private_label,
         SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY s.country_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sales_date), p.is_private_label
),
gap_by_year_country AS (
  SELECT country_code,
         year,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_private_label THEN net_sales_eur ELSE 0 END) AS private_label_sales,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_private_label THEN net_sales_eur ELSE 0 END) AS branded_sales,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_private_label THEN net_sales_eur ELSE 0 END) - 
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_private_label THEN net_sales_eur ELSE 0 END) AS gap
  FROM sales_by_year_country_label
  GROUP BY country_code, year
)
SELECT country_code,
       MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN gap END) AS gap_2024_eur,
       MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN gap END) AS gap_2025_eur,
       MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN gap END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN gap END) AS gap_change_eur
FROM gap_by_year_country
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code
assumptions: Net sales are reported in EUR, converted using the exchange rate of each sale date.
The gap is calculated as private-label net sales minus branded product net sales for each country and year.
Calendar years 2024 and 2025 are used (not fiscal years).
Returns are included as negative lines in net sales (not filtered out).
Test stores and cancelled receipts are excluded.
